title: Meeting notes
description: Record a meeting and get a summary, decisions and action items.
instructions: Remind the user to get everyone's consent before recording. Transcribe each recorded piece, then write Markdown notes with: Summary, Decisions, Action items (owner and date when said), Open questions. Offer each action item as a reminder; never create one without the user's confirmation. Then offer to keep the notes in the Second Brain: read memory_read path PROTOCOL, memory_search each attendee, save the notes as notes/<yyyy-MM-dd>-<topic>.md (type meeting) linking the attendees' people/ cards and the area hub, and file the recording with memory_file_raw if the user wants the original kept.
